entries.userExpectation: Connect Slack and receive replies after wake-from-sleep.
entries.verificationSignal: OAuth or manual credentials, /slack/events route readiness, lastForward accepted, and user-visible reply observation.
entries.nextAction: Keep setup, readiness, wake forwarding, and user-visible reply checks green.

entries.userExpectation: Connect a Telegram bot and receive replies after wake-from-sleep.
entries.verificationSignal: Bot token validation, registered webhook, port 8787 listener, lastForward accepted, and user-visible reply observation.
entries.nextAction: Keep webhook secret flow, native listener readiness, and wake forwarding verified.

entries.userExpectation: Connect Discord interactions and receive final replies.
entries.verificationSignal: Endpoint configured, /ask command registered, route ready, native accepted, and user-visible reply verified.
entries.nextAction: Keep marked experimental until real platform delivery and user-visible replies are verified end to end.
entries.alternativePath: Use local/upstream OpenClaw for unverified Discord behavior.

entries.userExpectation: Connect WhatsApp and receive replies through the hosted deployment.
entries.verificationSignal: Meta webhook verification, linked gateway state, lastForward accepted, and user-visible reply verified.
entries.nextAction: Keep marked experimental until setup and reply visibility are proven across real Meta delivery.
entries.alternativePath: Use local/upstream OpenClaw for unverified WhatsApp behavior.

entries.userExpectation: Connect channels such as iMessage, LINE, Matrix, Teams, Signal, Twitch, WeChat, or Zalo.
entries.upstreamEvidence: Upstream docs list many channel adapters beyond Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp.
entries.verificationSignal: No hosted credential storage, webhook route, wake forwarding, lastForward, or user-visible reply contract exists for these channels.
entries.nextAction: Add one hosted vertical slice at a time before presenting a channel as available.
entries.alternativePath: Run local/upstream OpenClaw and configure the channel in that runtime.

entries.userExpectation: Open the hosted OpenClaw UI and chat through the proxied gateway.
entries.upstreamEvidence: OpenClaw exposes a web UI and gateway routes.
entries.verificationSignal: Authenticated /gateway proxy, HTML injection, WebSocket rewrite, heartbeat, and launch verification chatCompletions.
entries.nextAction: Keep gateway auth, token handoff, and launch verification aligned.

entries.userExpectation: Pair hosted OpenClaw with local or mobile companion nodes.
entries.upstreamEvidence: Upstream docs describe companion nodes and Gateway WebSocket pairing.
entries.verificationSignal: The hosted wrapper has no verified secure node discovery, pairing auth, persistence, or launch-verification contract for companion nodes.
entries.nextAction: Do not advertise hosted companion-device support until pairing, auth, proxying, persistence, and verification exist.
entries.alternativePath: Use local/upstream OpenClaw for companion-node workflows.

entries.userExpectation: Use hosted voice/audio routing and the macOS Canvas panel.
entries.upstreamEvidence: Upstream docs describe voice wake, talk behavior, and canvas surfaces.
entries.verificationSignal: The hosted wrapper has no verified audio route, device permission model, canvas persistence, or smoke test.
entries.nextAction: Keep these out of hosted-ready copy until one capability is implemented and verified end to end.
entries.alternativePath: Use local/upstream OpenClaw for voice and canvas features.

entries.userExpectation: Install, update, verify, remove, and recover arbitrary plugins and skills from the hosted admin UI.
entries.upstreamEvidence: Upstream docs describe npm plugins, local extension loading, ClawHub skills, and migrations.
entries.verificationSignal: The hosted sandbox verifies only the plugins, skills, sidecars, and runtime assets shipped in the pinned OpenClaw bundle.
entries.nextAction: Define persistence, restore, compatibility checks, rollback, and launch verification before offering install/update UI.
entries.alternativePath: Use local/upstream OpenClaw for arbitrary plugin and skill installation.

entries.feature: MCP, browser tools, and runtime tools
entries.userExpectation: Configure arbitrary MCP bridges and browser/tool integrations in the hosted sandbox.
entries.upstreamEvidence: Upstream docs mention MCP via mcporter and tool integrations.
entries.verificationSignal: Hosted verification covers only the tool surface included in the pinned bundle plus wrapper firewall/network policy behavior.
entries.nextAction: Add an explicit compatibility and firewall contract before exposing arbitrary hosted MCP/tool setup.
entries.alternativePath: Use local/upstream OpenClaw for custom MCP and tool configuration.

entries.userExpectation: Persist scheduled OpenClaw jobs across sandbox sleep and restore.
entries.upstreamEvidence: OpenClaw can schedule jobs inside its runtime.
entries.verificationSignal: Persisted cron wake key and jobs JSON, watchdog wake, restore write-back, and gateway restart evidence.
entries.nextAction: Keep watchdog verification separate from actual chat completion execution.

entries.feature: Model/provider access through Vercel AI Gateway
entries.userExpectation: Use the hosted deployment with the configured model provider without leaking provider tokens into the sandbox.
entries.verificationSignal: Preflight, launch verification chatCompletions, OPENAI_BASE_URL in sandbox, and AI Gateway transform rules in networkPolicy.
entries.nextAction: Keep token refresh and firewall policy verification green.
